name: boss-battle.opus
title: File:8-bit Music for GameDev - 03. Boss Battle.opus
source: Wikimedia Commons - part of the artist's '8-bit Music for GameDev' set, dedicated to the public domain for use in games
usage: Thinking music while the 30-second clue timer runs. The default track: chiptune boss music, which is the closest legitimate thing to a game-show countdown for a class this age. Downloaded unedited; the widget only ever plays the opening 30 seconds and fades it out.

name: slay-the-evil.opus
title: File:8-bit Music for GameDev - 01. Slay The Evil.opus
source: Wikimedia Commons - same '8-bit Music for GameDev' set as boss-battle.opus
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. Faster and brighter than Boss Battle, so it is the one for the 100s and 200s where the clock is about pace rather than pressure. Downloaded unedited.

name: time-attack.ogg
title: File:Komiku - 44 - Time Attack against the universe.ogg
source: Wikimedia Commons - from Komiku's public-domain game-music catalogue
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. Forty seconds long, which is the whole track and barely longer than the countdown itself. Downloaded unedited.

name: r2d2-bass.ogg
title: File:Frederic Lardon - 03 - R2D2 needs to play bass with me.ogg
source: Wikimedia Commons - released into the public domain by the artist
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. The funk one, and the one for the trivia categories. Shown in the picker as 'R2D2 Plays Bass'; the artist's full title is longer. Downloaded unedited.

name: phonk.opus
title: File:WhiteWhyne - current (Phonk x Synthwave Instrumental, Dark & Atmospheric Beats).opus
source: Wikimedia Commons - the only track here that is NOT public domain. CC BY 3.0 requires attribution, which is why the artist's name is carried in this file and in the teacher plan. Do not strip it.
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. Phonk and synthwave, which is the genre this age group actually listens to - the reason it is here at all. Downloaded unedited.
